card.name: René “Loup” Arcemont: Night Runner
card.text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card.

card.name: Lunar Office
card.text: When you score this agenda, gain 9[credit].

printing.flavor_text: A frontier office with an impossible view.

card.name: Spin Specialist
card.text:
When you rez this asset, draw 1 card.
Remove this asset from the game: Shuffle up to 3 cards from Archives into R&D.

printing.flavor_text: Every disaster becomes tomorrow's talking point.

card.name: Anoetic Gate
card.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 1[credit] and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

printing.flavor_text: The Net folds around those who know where to press.
Capital moves fastest when nobody asks why.

card.name: Ballista Prime
card.text:
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] End the run.

printing.flavor_text: A sharper answer to an old question.

card.name: Carmen v2
card.text:
If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 1[credit] less to install.
Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine.
2[credit]: +2 strength.

card.name: Carnivore II
card.text:
+1[mu]
Access → Trash 2 cards from your grip: Trash the card you are accessing. Use this ability only once per turn.
Limit 1 console per player.

printing.flavor_text: It learned to hunger for harder problems.

card.name: Smartware Distributor+
card.text:
Place 4[credit] on this resource.
When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.

printing.flavor_text: Good hardware survives. Great hardware finds a buyer.
Make the odds look like luck.
